notes: Distant massifs. ART_BIBLE 4 (alpine): exposed rock is DARK and wet-looking, the summit is near-white with a faint cool cast, and the shadow is unmistakably blue at low contrast. The vertical gradient runs over 240 m so a 380 m peak reads pale at the cap and sinks into its own shadow at the base — which is the only reason a cone silhouette holds up at 3 km. gradientBase/gradientHeight are OBJECT space and this geometry is unit-sized: metre-scale values here saturate the sweep to a constant and switch the vertical gradient off entirely, which is how every instanced asset in the greybox lost it. rampSoftness widened from a near-cel width: on a facet whose N.L is almost constant, a half-width that tight lets the micro-relief flip the terminator back and forth within a pixel or two, and the result is the ragged navy/cream boundary with magenta-cyan chromatic fringing visible down the shaded faces in shots/lagoon-morning.png. A wider step turns the same signal into a gradient the resolve and the chromatic aberration can both survive.
